text: Implemented immutable BidiLine/BidiCodepoint data plus NativeUnicode.resolveLine. Adapter uses the generated C API actual BidiInfo and upstream unicode-bidi 0.3.18 L1/L2, no Unicode rule patches. All 91707 BidiCharacterTest records passed exact paragraph base levels, X9/adjusted levels and visual codepoint indices; wrapped whitespace, preserved paragraph context, supplementary/combining ranges, invalid/cross-paragraph ranges, budget, thread and closure tests passed. Existing 22143 segmentation records still pass. Full JVM/Native/font verification running.
